Name: Alchemist's Fire
Description: A ceramic container of alchemist's fire can be loaded into a catapult or trebuchet. On impact, it deals 4d6 fire damage in addition to the siege engine's normal damage, and creatures within 5 feet take 2d6 fire damage.

Name: Blast Shot
Description: This ammunition shatters on impact, dealing additional damage in a small area.

Name: Bomb
Description: A bomb is a container filled with explosive powder. It deals additional damage when used as siege ammunition.

Name: Chain Shot
Description: Two cannonballs linked by a chain, this ammunition is designed to destroy rigging and sails.

Name: Defoliant Shot
Description: This ammunition releases a cloud of defoliant on impact, destroying plant matter.

Name: Entangling Bolt
Description: This ballista bolt releases a net or sticky strands on impact, entangling targets.

Name: Liquid Ice
Description: This alchemical substance deals cold damage on impact. It deals 4d6 cold damage in addition to the siege engine's normal damage.

Name: Plague Bundle
Description: This bundle contains diseased materials that can spread plague when launched.

Name: Rockwasp Bomb
Description: This container holds a swarm of rockwasps that are released on impact.

Name: Smoke Shot
Description: This ammunition creates a large cloud of smoke on impact, providing concealment.
